bio.name: Michael Eickmeyer
bio.subtitle: Master's Student in Visual Computing @
bio.intro: Hi there, name's Michael! Happy to have you here.
bio.focus: I am a master's student at TU Wien in Vienna, currently majoring in Visual Computing. My primary focus lies in Computer Graphics and Visualization, but I dabble often enough in other areas for it to not really matter.
bio.below: Down below you will find all my current projects, publications, and whatever other stuff I feel like sharing with the world. I am also currently working on an interactive, introductory online textbook & slidedeck about physically-based rendering called Lightcraft. You can find the current version for completely free, along with my visualization projects, on the right side of the header!
bio.milestone1: I obtained my B.Sc. in Media Inf. & Visual Computing in 2025 under the supervision of Prof. Michael Wimmer.
bio.milestone2: From 2022 - 2026, I aided the development of the DigiFit4All & Dev0land CS education projects at eduLAB.
bio.milestone3: I ran my first half marathon this year and survived! (wohoo!)

interests.list: Monte-Carlo Rendering, Path Guiding, Real-time Rendering, Denoising, Acceleration Structures, CS Education
